user.title: Add feed
user.description: Enter the URL of an RSS or Atom feed.

data_description.url: The address of the RSS or Atom feed to watch.
data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the title reported by the feed.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the feed URL.
error.invalid_feed: The URL did not return a valid RSS or Atom feed.

data_description.update_interval: How often the feed is polled.
data_description.initial_items: How many of the newest items to announce when the feed is first added. 0 announces nothing.
data_description.max_items_per_poll: Maximum number of items announced per poll. Remaining items are announced on later polls. 0 means unlimited.
